subject: Re: Scheduling cascade — Aurora tech + procurement walkthrough
body:
From: Tom Hargrave <tom.hargrave@auroratech.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.shah@auroratech.com; lee.wong@auroratech.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora walkthrough — urgent hold and procurement gating

Hi Soojin / Dylan,

Heads up — our SSO provider is experiencing a regional outage this morning and our security team has paused any external demo access that requires SAML until they confirm the impact. Procurement also surfaced a blocker: they need SOC2 evidence and an updated data residency note before they can approve the calendar invite for any upcoming vendor sessions.

Can we pause the full product walkthrough originally planned for Aug 7? If possible, we'd like to instead schedule a short handoff (20–30 min) for internal stakeholders that doesn't require SSO access, or push the full demo past procurement approval. Procurement is asking for a doc they can attach to the PO by Aug 12.

Attendees (internal): Priya (security), Lee (procurement). I can be the customer coordinator.

Apologies for the churn — we want to avoid a wasted SE deep-dive if procurement won't greenlight access yet.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Platform Ops, AuroraTech

---

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 10:18 AM soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hargrave <tom.hargrave@auroratech.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, priya.shah@auroratech.com, lee.wong@auroratech.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora walkthrough — urgent hold and procurement gating

Tom — thanks for the heads-up. Totally makes sense to avoid the full walkthrough while procurement/security are gating access.

Two quick proposals so we don't lose momentum:
- Option A: Short technical handoff (30 min, no SSO required). Content: scope, success criteria, and next steps for procurement. Can be recorded for your broader team.
- Option B: Hold full SE-led demo until procurement confirms (target after Aug 12).

Proposed short slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 9, 11:00–11:30
- Tue Aug 9, 16:00–16:30
- Thu Aug 12, 09:00–09:30 (if procurement signs off quickly)

Dylan — can you or Aditya cover a 30 min handoff on Aug 9? If not, let us know the earliest window after Aug 15 when you have full SE availability.

I attached a one-page agenda and an updated scheduling matrix (aurora_mtd_sched_v2.pdf) to help procurement. I can also export the SOC2 evidence checklist we maintain for customers as a doc for Priya.

Action: Tom — confirm whether a short handoff works and which slot you prefer.

Best,
Soji n Lee (she/her)
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: aurora_mtd_sched_v2.pdf, short-demo-agenda.txt

---

On Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 08:07 AM dylan_brooks@redwood.ai wrote:
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, Tom Hargrave <tom.hargrave@auroratech.com>, priya.shah@auroratech.com
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora walkthrough — urgent hold and procurement gating

So — thanks for coordinating. Quick note on SE coverage: I have travel scheduled Aug 10–12 and won't be available for follow-ups in that window. Aditya can cover the short handoff on Aug 9 — he ran the last POC and knows their infra. If the customer prefers a deeper technical demo (full KV cache walkthrough, quantization Q&A), I recommend scheduling that for the week of Aug 17 when I return.

For the 30-min handoff I'd keep the agenda tight:
- 5 min: introductions & goals
- 10 min: architecture map + SSO constraint note
- 10 min: procurement evidence items & delivery plan
- 5 min: immediate next steps + recording link

Aditya — can you take the 11:00 slot on Aug 9 and record? If not, tell us which of the proposed times you can do.

Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

On Mon, Aug 9, 2026 at 14:18:00 -0700 soojin_lee@redwood.ai wrote:
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Tom Hargrave <tom.hargrave@auroratech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@auroratech.com>, Lee Wong <lee.wong@auroratech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling cascade — Aurora tech + procurement walkthrough

Tom / Priya / Lee — thank you for quick replies and clarity on procurement timing. Per Dylan's note, Aditya can cover a focused handoff.

I booked the short session for Tue Aug 9, 11:00–11:30 PDT and invited your procurement and security contacts. Agenda (attached short-demo-agenda.txt) and a draft SOC2 evidence packet (soc2-evidence-request.docx) are attached. We'll record and share the recording + a short transcript.

If procurement can sign the PO before Aug 12 and wants the full technical demo, we'll stand up a deep-dive week of Aug 17. If procurement is later, we'll keep the handoff and follow up with the recorded deep-dive.

Quick logistics:
- Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/999-888-777 (in calendar invite)
- Recording + notes will be posted to the HubSpot deal and a shared Drive folder after the call.
- Aditya will lead the screen share and capture the architecture slide; Dylan will be available as backup after Aug 17 for the deep-dive.

Tom — please confirm that Aug 9 11:00 works for Priya & Lee. Lee, if you need a procurement packet in a particular template, ping me and I’ll adapt the doc.

Thanks all — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
So ojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: soc2-evidence-request.docx, short-demo-agenda.txt
